notes.title: Game Walkthrough
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to the walkthrough for Lily! [/b]🌟 

Dive into the chilling world of Lily’s past, ready your flashlight 🔦 and steel your nerves—it’s time to uncover the horrors that lie within! 😱



[b]1.I need a key. [/b]🔑 

So where is the key? Check the desk drawer on the other side of the door, and you’ll find the key.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139994/7bb4a132b72884bc78fa7a770b5ef2bd92078d0b.gif[/img]


[b]2.A terrifying magic circle! [/b]🌀 

Don’t rush to run away. There’s a flashlight in the center of the circle, and I’m sure it will be helpful for your journey ahead.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139994/98ec5082e5a871e19d9ac55d9d27e4ad9c1d9d2e.gif[/img]


[b]3.Oh no, a bookshelf is blocking my way.[/b] 📚 

In the drawer of the eerie desk next to the bookshelf, you can find a book. Place it in the empty slot on the bookshelf.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139994/1ac8c0f17a052a9ff455d7c6cacb6ef4aad8cce2.gif[/img]


[b]4.A messy classroom. [/b]

There is a classroom at the end of the corridor. Go inside and move the desks and other clutter, you’ll find a key near the doll that opens the door next to it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139994/8ecb260f37c2e508140ee6e76e0d6b424323de08.gif[/img]


[b]5.Monster alert! What should I do? [/b]👹 

Don’t panic, quickly hide in the closet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139994/44fbdffc2ab69010ffa43b330467cd530cd658f5.gif[/img]


[b]6.A dark hospital. [/b]🏥 

Remember to turn on the light. The switch is next to the cabinet. Then open the door and… jump! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139994/8a9d996b53b47f0e5eee1059858225ad81f934eb.gif[/img]


[b]Enjoy the game! [/b]🎮 

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 
Thank you!
